_comment: W21-F: what stands along the river, built at run time by Settlements from layouts that already exist (data/structures/pois/). The owner asked for villages and camps along the river 'just like Elden Ring'; this is the modest first pass, and it also closes the reach gap tests/test_world_reach.gd found at (0, -380): the far bank of the Wide Water, a 7 m strip between the bank's rim and the ridge clearance, had nothing on it, so a walker there was 95 m from anything built. FAR BANK: a lost hearth and a waymarker cairn, the fire somebody who was waiting to cross did not walk away from (The Drowned March 'takes whoever tries the crossing', data/places.json). WIDE WATER CAMP: a travellers' camp and its cairn on the south bank at the hanging bridge's foot. LAST MOUTH CAMP: a camp, a bank fire and a cairn on the south bank of the river's last reach, between Riverend and the western crossing. Scenery only, no props, no new names: nothing here is in data/places.json because none of it is a named place. Every spot was checked with tools/site_check.gd; the far-bank sites sit as near the rim as the ridge clearance (25 m) allows.
